controls: same-space exact literal yields a lexical candidate
duplicate target literals are ambiguous and cannot produce a unique candidate
missing, empty, case-different, namespace-different and unsupported forms do not match
identical relative RDF literals under different xml:base contexts still yield a lexical candidate and must abstain from semantic promotion
calibration.method: deterministic synthetic positive, negative, ambiguity and base-context controls
calibration.promotion_rule: abstain; no literal-only candidate is emitted as a semantic edge
calibration.source_semantic_precision: not estimable from aggregate-only source receipt

exact_source_screen.interpretation: candidate yield, not precision, recall, semantic validity, or relation accuracy

limits: not a global PBS item key
not a terminology identity or medicine-equivalence assertion
item_xml_id.screen_rule: identifier occurrence and duplicate count only

rdf_resource_to_rdf_about.meaning: RDF resource literal with a same-spelling RDF subject candidate
rdf_resource_to_rdf_about.screen_rule: binary literal equality in the RDF namespace only

xlink_fragment_to_xml_id.meaning: XLink fragment literal with a same-spelling XML ID candidate
missing_context: link role and source/target element types
fragment target semantics for this link occurrence
xlink_fragment_to_xml_id.screen_rule: leading # removed only for nonempty fragment syntax, then binary equality in the XML-ID namespace
